import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df, target_values=[1, 3, 4]):
    allowed = set(target_values)
    transformed = df.copy()

    for column in transformed.columns:
        transformed[column] = transformed[column].where(transformed[column].isin(allowed), 0)

    if transformed.shape[1] == 0:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.set_axis_off()
        ax.set_title("Empty DataFrame")
        return ax

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        nrows=transformed.shape[1],
        ncols=1,
        figsize=(8, max(4, 3 * transformed.shape[1]))
    )

    if transformed.shape[1] == 1:
        axes = [axes]

    last_ax = None
    for ax, column in zip(axes, transformed.columns):
        sns.countplot(x=transformed[column].astype(str), ax=ax)
        ax.set_title(column)
        ax.set_xlabel(column)
        ax.set_ylabel("count")
        last_ax = ax

    plt.tight_layout()
    return last_ax
